timings.subject: warm same-browser navigation start until the six external SVG image resources are loaded and decoded with non-zero intrinsic dimensions; unrelated template CDN load is observed but is not diagram readiness

diagrams.handbookAlt: Production rifleman and contact split into a blocking-cover stop branch and a separate unblocked armor-and-damage branch
diagrams.handbookCaption: The established battlefield glyph and overlay vocabulary separates a cover-stopped impact from the representative unblocked attack outcome. Motion and glow are optional emphasis. effects-off view
diagrams.transcript: A production rifleman occupies its faction-outlined unit footprint. Its authoritative trace reaches first contact, where two distinct outcomes separate. On the upper branch, projectile-blocking cover consumes the collision, stops the projectile, and produces zero target harm. On the lower, unblocked branch, armor retains eighty percent; the resulting twenty-point harm leads to an injury classification, stress, and collateral fields in one atomic consequence. The named rule bindings are COMBAT-TRACE-002, COMBAT-COLLISION-001, COMBAT-COVER-003, COMBAT-ARMOR-004, COMBAT-DAMAGE-001, COMBAT-HEALTH-001, COMBAT-WOUND-001, COMBAT-SUPPRESSION-001, COMBAT-COLLATERAL-001, and COMBAT-ATTACK-RESOLUTION-001. Static geometry, labels, caption, and this transcript carry the complete meaning.

diagrams.handbookAlt: Checked atomic transition from a cohesive pre-state and attack input to a post-state and observation
diagrams.handbookCaption: A checked transition maps one cohesive pre-state and input to one post-state and observation; invalid input disables the operation. effects-off view
diagrams.transcript: The authoritative initial pre-state has vitality one hundred, stress zero, barrier integrity one hundred, active blocking, and remains capable. Attack input enters a validity predicate. The atomic consequence produces a complete post-state with vitality eighty, stress twelve, unchanged barrier fields, and continued capability, plus a separate observation with harm twenty and no injury classification at that threshold. Invalid input disables the operation, so it creates neither a transition nor a hidden partial state.

diagrams.handbookAlt: Eight direct rule dependencies converge on the aggregate attack-resolution rule
diagrams.handbookCaption: The aggregate rule's eight authoritative direct dependencies converge on the final composite result; explanatory sequencing remains a separate deterministic sequence. effects-off view
diagrams.transcript: Engagement, collision, cover, perforation, harm, injury, stress, and collateral each have one arrow directly into COMBAT-ATTACK-RESOLUTION-001. This is the aggregate rule's immediate dependency collection from the catalogue, not the wider transitive graph. The arrows do not claim execution order or hidden intermediate states.

diagrams.handbookAlt: Twenty-five times full trace retention times eighty-percent armor retention equals twenty
diagrams.handbookCaption: Raw scale-ten-thousand operands make the representative twenty-point calculation visible without floating point. effects-off view
diagrams.transcript: The rifle starts at twenty-five, encoded as 250000 raw. Full trace retention is 10000 raw and protective retention is 8000 raw. Each fixed-point multiplication divides by scale 10000; the declared tie-breaking rule produces 200000 raw, which is a twenty-point result.

diagrams.handbookAlt: Separate original-model and altered-model traces compare a twenty-point example with an eighteen-point failing trace
diagrams.handbookCaption: The original and altered transition systems are separate: one supplies the representative example, while the other supplies the deliberately failing trace. effects-off view
diagrams.transcript: The original model starts at its initial state and reaches harm twenty with vitality eighty, satisfying the representative assertion. The established retention change from 8000 to 7000 creates a separate altered transition system; its own reachable trace reaches harm eighteen with vitality eighty-two and violates that assertion. The red edge is the altered model's failing path, not a nondeterministic branch of the unchanged model and not a claim about every execution.

diagrams.handbookAlt: Reachable states remain inside a safety boundary until a mutated transition escapes
diagrams.handbookCaption: The safety boundary encloses checked reachable states; one mutated transition escapes to a concrete violating path. effects-off view
diagrams.transcript: The safe region contains reachable combat states from one hundred vitality through zero vitality with incapacity aligned. A deliberately mutated bound permits vitality minus one, placing the successor outside the boundary. The diagram explains a checked predicate and adds no model state.
